svg.title: BearAgent P1 implemented architecture
svg.desc: A five-layer architecture diagram showing CLI and configuration, application orchestration, the runtime core, ports and adapters, and local data. Only implemented P1 behavior is included.

g.text: Inspectable, local-first Agent Runtime · current P1 implementation

svg.text: ports keep external types outside the core

g.text: provider selection · agent instructions · hard budgets
SQLite + selected model adapter + fixed Policy + workspace Tools
creates Run facts · stops on terminal result or bounded failure
stable order · complete interaction groups · Tool schemas
read-only application path through the EventStore port
typed IDs · frozen schemas · safe ErrorInfo
SDK objects and database rows stop at adapters
model · Tool · token · cost · wall time
pure state reduction · no I/O · no hidden retry
every Tool call crosses the same boundary
timeout · cancellation · bounded usage · safe errors
path boundary · output limits · atomic replace
migration ledger · sequence checks · corruption fails closed
Event is the source of truth; projections are query views
list · chunked UTF-8 read · literal search

svg.text: Current boundary: single user · single Agent · single process · CLI + SQLite · no HTTP, MCP, Approval, sandbox, or automatic recovery.
